title.zh: 对第 8339 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 8339, Entitled "An Act Granting Air Philippines Corporation (Air Philippines) a Franchise to Establish, Operate and Maintain Domestic and International Air Transport Services"
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 8339, Entitled "An Act Granting Air Philippines Corporation (Air Philippines) a Franchise to Establish, Operate and Maintain Domestic and International Air Transport Services"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2003/ra_9215_2003.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 11 of Republic Act No. 8339 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 11. Tax Provisions. - The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall pay to the Philippine Government during the life of its franchise a franchise tax of five percent (5%) of the gross revenues derived by the grantee from its transport operations.
In the event that any competing individual, partnership or corporation receives or enjoys tax privileges and other favorable terms which tend to place the herein grantee at any disadvantage, then such provisions shall be deemed ipso factopart hereof and shall operate equally in favor of the grantee. The grantee shall, however, be subject to income tax levied under Title II of the National Internal Revenue Code, as amended, and tax on its real property under existing laws on revenues earned from activities other than air transportation."

Section 14 of Republic Act No. 8339 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 14. Dispersal of Ownership. - In accordance with constitutional provisions to encourage public participation in public utilities, the grantee shall offer at least thirty percentum (30%) of its outstanding capital stock or a higher percentage that may hereafter be provided by law in any securities exchange in the Philippines within ten (10) years from the commencement of its operations. Non-compliance therewith shall render the franchise ipso facto revoked.

Section 15 of Republic Act No. 8339 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 15. Non-exclusivity Clause. - This franchise shall not be interpreted to mean as an exclusive grant of the privileges herein provided for.

Section 17 of Republic Act No. 8339 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 17. Repealability Clause. - This franchise shall be subject to amendment, alteration or repeal by the Congress of the Philippines when the public interest so requires.

Separability Clause. - If any of the sections or provisions of this Act is held or declared unconstitutional or invalid by a competent court in a final judgment, all the other sections or provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days from the date of its publication, upon the initiative of the grantee, in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
